answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in zephyr, expire in violet, and vertex lists each expiry. An farming party running 152 aliases therefore needs 90 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1315 identities would post 2516 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
